sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.attribution: Contains information from OpenStreetMap contributors, made available under the Open Database Licence.
sources.covers: The place catalog, trail and route lines derived from OpenStreetMap, and geocoding through Nominatim.

sources.name: OpenRouteService
sources.licence: Routes computed from OpenStreetMap data, ODbL 1.0
sources.attribution: Road routes: OpenRouteService (openrouteservice.org), from OpenStreetMap data, ODbL.
sources.covers: The road and path routes drawn on a trip's map and written into its GPX and KML files, and the drive and walk times between stops.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.covers: Place coordinates, elevations and identifiers resolved when a place is added.

sources.name: Government of Canada open data
sources.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Canada.
sources.covers: Canadian parks, trails and boundary data where used.

sources.name: US National Park Service
sources.attribution: Information from the US National Park Service.
sources.covers: US national park facts, trails and alerts.

sources.name: opendata.swiss
sources.licence: Open use (terms vary by dataset; attribution required for some)
sources.attribution: Swiss open government data from opendata.swiss, used under each dataset's terms.
sources.covers: Swiss trail and transport data where used.

sources.name: Open-Meteo
sources.covers: Forecasts and historical weather shown on plan pages.

sources.name: Copernicus Climate Change Service, via Open-Meteo
sources.attribution: Generated using Copernicus Climate Change Service information, delivered through Open-Meteo.
sources.covers: Reanalysis behind the historical weather figures.

sources.name: Natural Earth
sources.covers: Country outlines on the globe, its landform, sea and river lines (the line files), and the city rows the globe search reads.

sources.name: world-countries (mledoze/countries)
sources.licence: ODbL 1.0 (Open Database Licence); flag images are not covered by it
sources.attribution: Contains information from mledoze/countries (world-countries), made available under the Open Database Licence (ODbL) 1.0.
sources.covers: Country facts on the globe: names, codes, capital, region and area.

sources.name: geoBoundaries
sources.licence: Per country (mostly CC BY 4.0 or ODbL)
sources.attribution: Administrative boundaries from geoBoundaries; the licence of each country's layer applies.
sources.covers: States, provinces and districts on the globe.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons
sources.licence: Per image (Creative Commons licences or public domain)
sources.attribution: Photographs from Wikimedia Commons; the author and licence of each image are on its Commons page.
sources.covers: Photographs on cards, place pages and plan galleries.

sources.name: Frankfurter and the European Central Bank
sources.licence: Free use; ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates
sources.attribution: Exchange rates are ECB reference rates served by Frankfurter, shown with their date.

sources.name: Our own words
sources.licence: Written for this site; not licensed for reuse
sources.attribution: Notes, summaries and plans on this site are our own writing.
sources.covers: Place notes, trip plans and research summaries.

sources.name: Statistics Canada
sources.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada (Statistics Canada, 2021 Census boundary files).
sources.covers: The census division boundaries for Canada on the globe.

sources.name: GeoNames
sources.attribution: Contains data from GeoNames, CC BY 4.0
sources.covers: The towns and cities layer: the names, positions and populations of places of 1,000 people or more, used for the nearest town of a place and for the city filter, shown as GeoNames has them.

privacy: Never published: traveller ages, heights, weights and citizenship; booking confirmations and contacts; prices paid; inbox captures; the research tree.
